title: Auth Pages
content: Build authentication pages. Login: email/password inputs, remember me checkbox, forgot password link, submit button, social login (Google, GitHub), sign up link. Signup: name, email, password (with strength), confirm password, terms checkbox, submit, social signup, login link. Split layout: form one side, branded visual other side. Validation. Loading states.

variants.simple: Create login and signup pages with forms and social auth.
variants.detailed: Build authentication pages. Login: email/password inputs, remember me checkbox, forgot password link, submit button, social login (Google, GitHub), sign up link. Signup: name, email, password (with strength), confirm password, terms checkbox, submit, social signup, login link. Split layout: form one side, branded visual other side. Validation. Loading states.
variants.advanced: Build comprehensive authentication pages with social login. Page layout: min-h-screen grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2. Left side (form): flex items-center justify-center p-8. Right side (branding): hidden lg:block, bg-gradient-to-br or image, testimonial or feature highlights. Form container: max-w-md w-full. Logo: centered, links to home. Login form: "Welcome back" heading (text-2xl font-bold), "Sign in to your account" subtext. Email input: label, text input, email validation. Password input: label, password input with show/hide toggle (Eye/EyeOff icons). Remember me: checkbox + label "Remember me for 30 days". Forgot password: text link aligned right. Submit button: w-full "Sign In", loading state with spinner. Divider: "Or continue with" text between horizontal lines. Social login: flex gap-4, Google button (with logo), GitHub button, Apple button. Style: outline with icon + text or icon-only. Sign up link: "Don't have an account? Sign up" with link. Signup form: "Create an account" heading, "Start your free trial" subtext. Name input: full name or first/last split. Email input: with validation. Password input: with strength meter (weak/fair/strong bar), requirements list (8+ chars, uppercase, number, symbol) showing check/x as typed. Confirm password: with match validation. Terms checkbox: required, "I agree to the Terms of Service and Privacy Policy" with links. Submit: "Create Account". Social signup, login link similar to login. Shared features: inline validation (red border, error text), success states (green check), loading during submit, error banner for failed attempts ("Invalid credentials"), rate limiting warning. Two-factor: if enabled, second step for code entry. Magic link: optional passwordless option. Mobile: single column, form centered. Accessibility: labels associated with inputs, errors linked via aria-describedby, focus management.
